title: LightMove role templates
description: A file of role templates for LightMove's Templates import. A template drafts the position brief of every new executive-search mandate whose role title matches one of its keywords. It never states a mandate's role title, location, target date or salary band: those belong to each mandate.

formatVersion.description: Version 1 files, whose body carried reportsTo and directReports instead of orgChart, still import.

code.description: The template's stable identity. Leave it out and one is made from the title. Reuse an existing code to change that template rather than add another.

discipline.description: How the template picker groups it.

seniority.description: C_SUITE is the executive committee; N_MINUS_1 reports to it.

summary.description: One line shown under the title in the picker.

keywords.description: Lower-case fragments. A new mandate whose role title contains any of them is drafted from this template, e.g. "cfo", "finance director".

mandateReason.description: The reason for hire the brief opens with. Leave it out to keep each mandate's own.

confidential.description: True drafts the brief as Confidential (restricted until shortlist). Leave it out to keep each mandate's own.

noticeValue.description: The Role Brief offers None, 1, 2, 3 or 6 months; the range stays wider so a template written before that, or outside the app, still round-trips.

narrative.description: The ideal-profile paragraph a consultant starts the brief from.

orgChart.description: The reporting structure as a tree of seats. Exactly one seat has mandateSeat true: the role itself, which carries no title because it takes the mandate's. Every parentId names another seat's id; a seat with no parentId is a root. Seats hold titles only, never people's names.

baseSalaryMode.description: The period a salary band is quoted over. Defaults to ANNUAL.

bonusValue.description: The target bonus, read against bonusBasis — a proportion, or money for FIXED_AMOUNT. At most two decimal places.

benefits.description: Allowance lines only. The amount is each mandate's to fill in.

criteria.description: Screening criteria. REQUIRED narrows the field; PREFERRED breaks ties.

technicalShare.description: The technical panel's share of the assessment in percent; the behavioural panel takes the rest. Defaults to 50.

competencies.description: Two panels, TECHNICAL and BEHAVIOURAL, of at most ten competencies each. The weights within each panel that has any competencies must total exactly 100.

id.description: Any short name unique within the chart, e.g. "ceo", "role".

parentId.description: The id of the seat this one reports to; null for a root.

title.description: The seat's job title. Leave it out on the mandate seat.

mandateSeat.description: True on exactly one seat: the role the template is for.
